notes.title: Rememoried Update #1
notes.content: The first official update for Rememoried brings more balance to the gameplay and a Y-axis inversion option. Based on the stats analysis, reviews and videos, number of returns to previous stages is reduced. Y-axis can be inverted by pressing the ‘/’ key while playing.
